dispositions.reason: Affects only the sqlite3 command-line shell's .recover dot-command, whose output can carry dot-commands such as .shell. GoPMgr links the library alone: the vendored sqlite3.c contains no shell or .recover code, and GoPMgr neither ships nor runs the shell. This holds for any SQLite version while that stays true; NVD's range for this CVE is open-ended.
evidence: https://www.sqlite.org/cves.html: "Not a bug in the core SQLite library" (read 2026-11-13)
third_party/go-sqlcipher/sqlite3.c has no match for sqlite3_recover, do_meta_command or .recover (2026-11-13)
